:::{#lem-shallow-T .callout-important icon="false"}
## (Shallow T circuit simulation)
 Any degree-3 IQP circuit with $d$ layers of diagonal gates can be compiled into one layer of $T$ gates, after appending $O(nd)$ pure ancillas initialized to $\ket{0}$.
:::

:::{#proof-shallow-T .callout-note icon="false"}
*Proof.* 

:::
